name: Antelope-horns
desc: Antelope-horns (Asclepias viridis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Asclepias viridis is a species of milkweed, a plant in the dogbane family known by the common names green milkweed, green antelopehorn and spider milkweed. The Latin word viridis means green.
